scope: RLL research intake and shadow tests
trigger_rule: When a newly observed mathematical, structural, statistical, geometric, biological, computational, or cross-domain relation admits a falsifiable mapping, diagnostic, null test, synthetic recovery, stability test, residual test, or observable-facing comparison relevant to RLL, register it automatically as a shadow candidate/test artifact.
automatic_actions: preserve exact source expression separately from any repaired test expression
bind only existing adequate graph references; otherwise TOKEN_VAZIO_NO_CANONICAL_GRAPH
record missing raw data, mapping, covariance, edge-list, units, likelihood, or observable as TOKEN_VAZIO
define falsifier or promotion gate when possible
keep affects_cosmology_evidence=false until independent empirical evidence exists
epistemic_chain: IDEA != FORMULA != IMPLEMENTATION != EXECUTION != EVIDENCE != CLAIM
